A LITTLE TRANSPARENCY

Your work stays yours.

Browser tools

Image, PDF, QR, Markdown, text comparison and OCR processing happen in your browser. Images, PDF files, QR content, Wi-Fi passwords and logos are not uploaded or saved to your workspace. QR appearance presets contain only colors and size. OCR downloads only the language packs you choose, and caches them in your browser. Existing text tools send text to cloud storage only when you explicitly save a signed-in draft. Answer Book and Decision Studio automatically save new or edited records: locally first, then privately to your signed-in account. Answer Book questions are never saved. Guest history is not automatically uploaded when you sign in.

Local workspace

Favorites, presets, saved drafts, timer settings and completed focus sessions are stored in this browser. Clearing browser storage removes local data. Use the workspace export to keep a backup.

Optional account

When configured, Google sign-in is provided through Supabase. Account identity and items you save are stored with Supabase, with access limited to your account. The application requests basic profile and email information, not access to your Google files.

Typing and device tests

Typing Practice scores stay in this browser. Ranked sends your completed input to Supabase to calculate a score; raw typed text is not retained. Qualifying best scores publish only your chosen nickname, speed, accuracy and date. English and Chinese use separate versioned boards. Device tests run only when started, stop when you leave their test area, and never save or upload key or mouse events.

Your controls

Delete or clear private histories in Workspace, export each history, or sign out. Autosave caches and retry queues are isolated by account. Conflicting scheme edits are kept as separate copies. Deleted cloud records retain an empty-content tombstone for sync; minimal retry receipts contain no saved record content. Signing out hides account data on this device. The platform does not add advertising trackers.

External destinations

About Me, 3A3D, GitHub and Pixiv are independent websites with their own privacy policies.
